basis: Named ATKIS watercourse axes compared with native tributary topology and index-1 join markers; neither cities nor inherited projections used.
model: one local affine longitude/latitude to native cell-centre diagnostic, six parameters; no optimisation, no second fit after holdout
source_axis_order: GML EPSG:4326 latitude/longitude; normalized to longitude/latitude
native_coordinate_convention: Upper-left origin; an index-1 marker at column x,row y is observed at [x+0.5,y+0.5]. Marker cell is an uncertain rasterised junction, not exact geodetic point.

controls.identification: Second major south-bank Danube tributary after Iller in west-east order; Lech valley topology.
Eastern large Inn-Danube junction; Inn upstream joined by Salzach.
Southern branch joining lower Inn before its northward final run to Danube.
Danube tributary between Lech and Inn, upstream separate from Inn, matching independent Isar topology.

source_join_rule: Mean of all distinct exact shared endpoints of named main/tributary station axes inside the declared small source window. Multiple source mouths remain explicit alternatives, not silently selected to improve residuals.
rejection_rule: A single independent physical check is a diagnostic, not a territorial accuracy certificate. If its residual or sensitivity is comparable to target widths, no installation; if small, still require source boundary and local error support before transfers. No fixed universal two-pixel rule.
excluded: Iller: no exact shared named source-axis endpoint in this window
Regen and Naab: not represented as identifiable native branches here
